# Which LLM calls in your code are quietly costing you money?

> Paste your code and see every OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini call with no max-tokens cap, inside a loop, on a premium model, or using a retired model name, plus a monthly cost estimate from your own traffic guess. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
